source: written by Word 16 through its object model for the table of contents test (e_toc): the paragraphs typed, then the "Automatic Table 1" gallery entry inserted and updated
exercises: a table of contents from Word's gallery: a content control around a TOC field, its TOC Heading title, toc 1 and toc 2 lines that are links to _Toc bookmarks with a PAGEREF field each, and a last paragraph holding only the end of the field; Title and Heading 1/2
blocks: Berth income rose by a fifth this year, and the waiting list for visitor moorings is now closed until spring.
The new timetable meets every ferry with a bus, and the last one waits for late sailings.
The council will decide on the second phase in June.
